0.name: Great Blessing
0.message: Great fortune has arrived. Keep a bright heart, and go forward without fear.

1.name: Middle Blessing
1.message: Keep your heart steady and bide your time. Little by little, the gate of fortune opens.

2.name: Small Blessing
2.message: Faint lights gather into a torch, and small blessings into great joy.

3.name: Blessing
3.message: Follow the signs you are given. A good encounter will come of its own accord.

4.name: Blessing Yet to Come
4.message: The blossoms have not opened yet. Wait quietly—your season is still on its way.

5.name: Misfortune
5.message: Go slowly today. What bends does not break.

6.name: Great Misfortune
6.message: Rest a while and look within. Even the longest night ends in dawn.
